messages:
maya: ok team — small midnight PSA: we just flipped the GA banner live. saw steady traffic spikes for the last hour 🎉
sam: wait WHAT??? saw a blip on console earlier, congrats!! :tada: :confetti_ball:
jonah: legendary timing. who wants donuts tomorrow at the office? i vote maple bacon 🥐 :bagel:
ellie: donut + maple bacon = chaotic excellence. also +1 for caffeinated cheers at 9am ☕️
rafa: shoutout to @maya and infra for the smooth rollout. zero alerts on my watch — miracle 
ops-bot: deploy-notify: GA flag enabled by maya at 2026-03-23T00:12:34Z :white_check_mark:
sam: can we do a tiny social post? i made a silly GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/celebrate-launch-3o6ZsY9tYfH1a — can someone approve?
maya: love the GIF, go for it. also to celebrate: free lunch tomorrow for the team (sushi + plant-based option). sign up here: https://forms.redwood/lunch-signup
jonah: i made a 10-second bongo track for the channel — low-fi victory drum: https://vocaroo.com/xxxxx :bongo:
ellie: polling: which emoji should be the official milestone sticker? react with one: :rocket: = latency wins, :moneybag: = ARR flex, :sparkles: = vibes
rafa: reacted with :rocket:
sam: reacted with :sparkles: :sparkles:
maya: also quick note — if anyone wants a tiny physical token, we hid 5 sticker packs in the kitchen. first come first serve. no hoarding pls 😄
jonah: taking one for the team (and my succulents)
ellie: big thanks everyone. midnight launches are rough but this felt... celebratory instead of chaos. good vibes only ✨
ops-bot: reminder: incident channel remains the source of truth for any post-launch regressions. reporting link: https://incidents.redwood/report
rafa: bedtime for me. accountable for morning coffee distribution. good job team! :sleeping:
maya: night all — see you (and the sushi) tomorrow! :tada:
